results.title: Delhi SIR: Aadhaar alone not enough, BLOs asked to seek ‘citizenship proof’ from voters
results.content: Regarding those electors flagged for ‘no mapping’ notices, several BLOs claim that Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) were directing them to revisit voters and seek additional documents to establish that they were not ‘Bangladeshi’ or ‘Rohingya’

results.title: Divorce granted by foreign court on ground of irretrievable breakdown of marriage not legal: SC
results.content: In our view, the foreign divorce decree was passed in contravention of the existing matrimonial law in India and on a ground that is not even recognised statutorily, the bench said

results.title: Self-reliance means technological sovereignty, not just indigenous manufacturing: Rajnath Singh
